title: 7.3 Slope Fields

icans: I can find the slope of the segment at a point in a slope field.

I can sketch a solution curve that follows a slope field.

(AP® Practice) For the slope field of dy/dx = x², which is true?
(A) The slopes are the same along each vertical line and never negative.
(B) The slopes are the same along each horizontal line.
(C) The slopes are negative when x < 0.
(D) Every segment is horizontal.
